items.question: How safe is Turkey?
items.answer: We felt very safe in both Istanbul and Cappadocia. As with any major tourist city, keep normal street-smarts around crowded markets and transport hubs.

items.question: Is English commonly understood?
items.answer: Not universally. Our Airbnb host spoke English well, but we wouldn't assume everyone will. Learning a handful of Turkish words helps, and pronunciation is surprisingly straightforward once you get used to letters such as C and C-cedilla.

items.question: What could ruin my stay in Turkey?
items.answer: Trying to do Cappadocia in one morning. A windy day can cancel balloon flights entirely, and that is a painful failure mode if you've built the detour around one experience. Give yourself a second shot.
